Ibedo ku genogen?

strings.mdKbSmart: • Smart keybox fetch: ngiyo keybox ma kawoni ikum Google's revocation list (CRL) man temo yore madwong nitundu enwango keybox maber, ku backup ma tiye kende man caku tic pa Google. Tiyu iwi tap moko ci man mitu intanet (dakika 1-3).
strings.mdKbNet: • Keybox kud i network: kwanyu keybox kud i repository (GitHub) man egwoko i /data/adb/tricky_store/keybox.xml. Mitu intanet man tero dakika 1-3. Jutiyo kudu ka smart fetch upodhu nyo ka keybox juloko ku cing.
strings.mdRkpDiag: • RKP diagnosis: neno Remote Key Provisioning modules ma nwang, neno TEE attestation certificate version, man nyutho KmInstallKeybox tool state. Lokruok moko ope — nen pa piny ma tiyo kudu.
strings.mdWvDiag: • Widevine check (read-only): nyutho Widevine level indicators (L1/L3) from dumpsys, DRM (IDM) key-file presence, and related system properties. Eloko ngo piny moko cii.
strings.mdRkpManual: • Manual RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh manual. Yubu peko mi ketho cing ikum lembe ma jutimo ka automatic pass upodhu. Ngwec moko ci nyuthu lanyuth maleng pa lonyo/podho.
strings.mdRkpFull: • Full RKP fix: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/rkp_fix.sh full. Tiyo ku lembe ma tek man tero kare malac. Adwogi ma yot wok i ajikine.
strings.mdGmsReset: • Reset GMS: kwanyu Play Store man Google (GMS+GSF) lembe man ecaku tic kendu. Pi ketho cing ikum lembe kende — ecopo mulo ngo cal peri nyo karatasi peri.
strings.mdCertify: • Certification mi tuko: nen RKP certificate attestasion state pa jam tic man dwoko attestasion piny ka mitire. Mulo ngo lembe pa jumatiyo kudu.
strings.mdSoter: • SOTER yiko: yiko Google tic mi tic (SOTER) peko ma mako ketho cing ikum jam tic. Jutiyo kudu pi jam tic moko ma tiye ku SOTER kakare pa Play Integrity.
strings.mdPifApply: • Ti ku PIF: timo sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/apply_pif.sh tego. Ti ku lanyuth pa cing ma juyero (ma nen/ma malu) man dwoko pif.prop/pif.json manyen. Adwogi maleng wok in log.
strings.mdPifCheck: • PIF check: nyutho kite ma engine utiye kudu, karatasi mi cing (custom.pif.prop/pif.prop), man lembe ma jugoro. Nen kende — eloko ngo piny moko.
strings.mdCanary: • Canary update: runs sch /data/adb/modules/playintegrityfix/falcon_update_pif.sh -m. Nwangu Canary Engine manyen mi neno ni etiye ber ku RKP certificates (dwi mir aryo 2026).
strings.mdEngineDiag: • Engine diagnosis: ngiyo TrickyStoreOSS state (pid, logs), keybox files (active vs user), real vs spoofed device fingerprint, target.txt, security_patch.txt, RKP keys. Nyuthu pa two kende.
strings.btnKbSlotsPromote: ⬆️ Medu rwom mir aryo → ma kwong
strings.hintKbSlots: Module ne tiyo ku keybox ario: ma pire tek (ma leng, ma juwilo ngo) man ma mir aryo (ma jugwoko). Tab eni nyutho kabedo makani ma tiyo, loko paru, nyo medo rwom mir aryo ni piny ma pire tek ka jukwayu — ku gwoko piny man lembe ma jugoro.
strings.mdIntegrityDiag: • Integrity diagnosis: ngiyo TEE key import, library injection in keystore2, revocation status (CRL), protection-list coverage man RKP state. Kwan kende — eloko piny moko ope.
strings.confirmIntegrityFix:
... ucaku kendu.

Piny moko epe ma juwodho man keybox ma pire tek jumulo ngo.

Medu?
strings.mdKbSlots: • Keybox slots: nyutho kite ma slots ma kwong ku ma mir aryo utiye kudu man eloko paru ikind gi. Piny ma pire tek (/data/adb/falcon/keybox.xml) jugwoko kare ku kare man juwodhe ngo. Medu piny mir aryo ni piny ma pire tek mito yub ma yot.
strings.confirmKbSlotsPromote:
⬆️ Med kabedo mir aryo ni primary:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml doko the primary slot content.
• Primary ma kawoni jugwoko calu backup mapodi juloko ngo.
• Gin moko mbe ma juwodho — tic ne judwoko.
000#Conue?
strings.confirmKbSlotsClear:
🧹 Wek kabedo mir aryo:

• /data/adb/falcon/keybox2.xml jubi kwanyu.
• Kabedo mir acel jumulo ngo.

Medu?

strings.confirmKbSmart:
Smart keybox fetch (new in v3.17):

• Temo keybox ma kawoni i kum Google revocation list (CRL).
• Temo yore madwong nitundu keybox maleng unwange.
• Automatic backup + restarts #000## tic.

⚠️ Mitu intanet (1-3 min). Mediri?
strings.confirmKbNet:
Kwany keybox kud i intanet:

• Kwany keybox man eketho i tic.
• Jukethe nja (judwoko ngo i acaki). Mediri?
strings.confirmRkpManual:
Re-provision RKP keys:

• No data or keybox files are deleted.
• Reboot the phone afterwards.

Continue?
strings.confirmRkpFull:
Yub ma jik:

• Re-provisions RKP + restarts Google services.
• The device reboot automatically (nothing is wiped).

Continue?
strings.confirmGmsReset:
Cak kendu Google tic:

• GMS + Play Store + GSF — caku kendu kende.
• Piny moko epe ma jwigo man ibewok woko ngo.
• Jam tic eca caku kendu kende.
strings.confirmRkpForce:
Tego dwoko piny (Red Magic):

• Pi jam tic ma weko keybox ma unyai.
• Tiyu kadi nang key utiye maber.
• Data moko mbe ma juwodho.

Medi?
strings.confirmCertify:
Diyo Play Store certification:

• Cleres only the Store cache — your account is untouched.
• Caku kendu, man yab Store.

Continue?
strings.confirmSoter:
SOTER repair:

• Restart the vendor.soter service.
• Cleres the SOTER server data only.

Continue?
strings.confirmPifApply:
Ti ku lanyuth pa cing (PIF):

• Loko custom.pif.prop man ekethe i yo pa engine.
• Mitu ni caku kendu i ngeye.

Medu?
strings.confirmCanary:
Medu Canary fingerprint:

• Kwanyo Canary fingerprint manyen kud i Google.
• Syncs the security patch + restarts Google services (no wipe).

⚠️ Needs internet (1-3 min). Mediri?
